formula.assumptions: Planar rigid body; supplied world velocity and acceleration refer to the same assumed source point; rear offset r=(-L,0,0).
formula.velocity_shift: v_B = v_C + omega cross r; local vy_B = vy_C - L*w
formula.acceleration_shift: a_B = a_C + alpha cross r + omega cross (omega cross r)
formula.first_sample_policy: Unavailable, not filled with zero; denominator disclosed.
formula.not_body_component_derivative: a_B_local is inertial acceleration expressed in body axes; d(v_B_local)/dt additionally subtracts omega cross v_B_local.

evidence_chain: Collector shifts position and vy rearward but only rotates ax/ay.
Common10 adapter copies ax/ay exactly into ego.linear_acceleration_base_mps2.
Dataset feature indices3,4 contain these values; model ego_input Linear and ego_history GRU consume them.
limitations: Existing native train/val records omit original actor transform pitch/roll, world velocity and world acceleration; inverse reconstruction is conditional, not an independent raw-world measurement.
Position shifting includes pitch but recorded dynamics rotate only yaw. Full 3D correction cannot be proven from these logs.
The actual CARLA physics reference point may differ from the named actor center. Local CARLA source is supporting evidence, not build-hash proof of the executed dirty server.
Finite differences approximate interval-averaged angular/linear acceleration and expose quantization/jitter; they are not continuous-time ground truth.
This diagnosis does not attribute scalar speed-rate impulses or poor model accuracy solely to the missing point-shift terms.
